proposal: Native gray gradients at +/-1 original pixel; seven tangents per side at +/-0.3 orthogonal edge, 129 radial positions from 0.25 to 0.75 predicted edge. No semantic boundary claim. Peak is median of ties. Require five valid nonflat full profiles each side; otherwise explicitly unavailable. No rescale, no box or decision changes.
difference: Original grayscale spatial detail replaces old 256x9x9 learned-ROI channel statistics.
screen: Fixed higher mismatch is worse. >=20 supported low-deviation TRAIN errors and >=2 Real videos each >=3 errors, >=20 correct and same-video predicted-scale matched AUC>=0.55. Both axes reported, no automatically selected model, threshold or next stage.
limitations: Native strongest gradient may be texture/background/occluder, not target edge.
Source pixels add evidence but do not establish independent errors.
Previously exposed TRAIN only; correlated pairs are not independent samples.
No VAL/TEST, no fitting or claimed FA improvement; descriptive feasibility requires subsequent design review.
